articles.title: Nihon Kohden (TSE:6849) Following FTSE Exit Is The Valuation Now Too Cheap To Ignore
articles.summary: Nihon Kohden (TSE:6849) was removed from the FTSE All-World Index (USD) on 19 September 2026, following an index reshuffle that can trigger portfolio changes for index-tracking funds and some institutional investors. For context, Nihon Kohden shares closed at ¥1,625.0 on the latest trading day, with a 30-day share price return of 9.28% and a 90-day share price return of 13.92%.
